1.situation: Social housing waiting lists in the city have grown for a decade, while the number of homes completed each year has fallen. Families wait years for a first offer.
1.problem_consequence: families stay in unsuitable housing for years
1.rationale: The wait is the thing people complain about, and the thing the council reports on. Shortening it is what every party says it wants.
1.suit_attempts_note: a building programme in 2019 and a rent cap in 2022
1.change_long: An average wait of under two years for a first offer
1.agreed_consequence: families stay in unsuitable housing for years
1.rep_description: A queue that grows because fewer homes are let each year than households join the list.
1.rep_assumption: That the queue is one queue: allocation rules in fact split it into priority groups.
1.rep_omission: Households who give up and leave the list
